ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Uranus

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.
